The four primitives form a unified mathematical framework for understanding digital platform security. Auth rate limiting acts as a hard constraint on brute-force attempts, effectively collapsing high-volume attacks through exponential backoff. Credential stuffing exploits the statistical independence of reused credentials across breaches, creating a linear scaling of compromise probability with database size. Phishing introduces temporal dynamics where attacker patience and victim cognition determine the success window. Finally, OAuth app abuse and shared-link sprawl generate combinatorial explosion in exposure surfaces, transforming simple permissions into complex network vulnerabilities. Together, they define the complete lifecycle of an account compromise: from initial authentication barrier to final data exfiltration.
